examples: Mark the point before a risky refactor, then branch from it into a new session without touching the original.
Rewind a session that went down the wrong path to the turn where it was still on track.
Keep every session's recent bookmarks in the side rail and branch from one without opening that session.
how_to: Press the bookmark icon in a Claude Code terminal's header to open the bookmarks popup; type a name and press the add key at the top to mark the latest turn.
In the list, press the fork icon on a bookmark or a past turn to branch from there into a new session.
To rewind in place, tick the arm box in the popup footer and press the rewind icon; the full transcript stays on disk.
Press the eye icon on a bookmark to preview the last few chat messages before its point; how many (default 4) and whether the eye shows are settings of the bookmarks widget.
Drop the session bookmarks widget (this session) or the all bookmarks widget (every session, with the globe mark) from the widget drawer onto either rail.
media_exempt: a header icon pair and a modal over a live session; a capture needs a real Claude conversation, so none is recorded yet
name: Session bookmarks
summary: mark a point in a Claude Code conversation, then branch a copy cut there into a new session or rewind the session in place.
